sheets.title: Add key protection — desktop
sheets.caption: The sheet is a list of the keys the browser can enroll, each expanding in place: recovery key, passkey, age recipient, age passkey, AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS. The checkbox whose unchecked state made the passkey key do nothing, and the policy line that claimed every method unlocks alone, are gone.
sheets.before: A card with a policy line, a checkbox that made the Passkey key do nothing when cleared, and three keys
sheets.after: Recovery key and Passkey as the two front doors, then four rows that expand in place

sheets.title: age recipient — desktop
sheets.caption: A recipient and, optionally, the identity that proves it; or a new key pair made here, whose identity is saved to an age-keygen file before the record commits.
sheets.before: No way to enrol an age recipient
sheets.after: Recipient, identity to prove it, add and new-key keys

sheets.title: AWS KMS — desktop
sheets.caption: The connection is saved sealed in the vault in the same step; the key is then wrapped, opened again through KMS and compared with the vault key before it is committed.
sheets.before: No way to enrol a cloud key from Security
sheets.after: Key, region and credential fields, one commit key

sheets.title: Security after making an age key — desktop
sheets.caption: The new protector is listed and verified. It has Test and Remove; Preferred is drawn only for a wrap that opens the vault at the unlock screen, and the Password row lost the Remove that only removed its row.
sheets.before: Nothing to enrol; the Password row carries Preferred and Remove

sheets.title: Test an age recipient — desktop
sheets.caption: Test asks for the identity, opens the capsule and compares the root with this session's.

sheets.title: Capabilities › Encryption — desktop
sheets.caption: YubiKey and Azure Key Vault Keys are no longer offered: a browser cannot enrol either (ADR 0152). AWS KMS and Google Cloud KMS remain, because they can now be enrolled.
sheets.before: YubiKey, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault Keys, Google Cloud KMS

sheets.title: Connections › AWS KMS — desktop
sheets.caption: The Prefer key and the preference marks are gone: the preference changed no protector. What remains configures the credential the Add sheet and Test use.
sheets.before: Save, Prefer and Remove keys; "Not the encryption preference" mark
sheets.after: Save and Remove; Remove is absent while a protector on the key is enrolled

sheets.title: Connections › YubiKey — desktop
sheets.caption: A YubiKey recipient was sealed here for a preference nothing read, and an age-plugin recipient cannot be used by the browser at all. The page is gone.
sheets.before: A recipient form with Save, Prefer and Remove

sheets.title: The key vault glyph — desktop
sheets.caption: Its ceremony was a setup preference picker that told the person to enrol elsewhere, or asked a Host to authorize a cloud choice. It is now the Add sheet.
sheets.before: Setup preference: four pickers and Keep this preference
sheets.after: Add key protection, the same choices as Security

sheets.title: age recipient — phone
sheets.caption: The same sheet at 390 wide: fields at the phone's 16px floor, keys at 44px.
sheets.after: Recipient, identity, add and new-key keys
